concepts.def: All nodes connect to a central switch or hub; failure of one cable affects only that device.
All devices share a single backbone cable; cheap but a break disables the whole network.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Network Security — a core area of GCSE Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Network Security brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Network Security.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

Ring

mcqs.q: What is the scope of a local variable?
options: Stored on a local computer rather than a server.
Accessible everywhere in the program.
Only the root node.
Accessible only within the function/block where it is declared.
